NERDSPACE LABSDASHBOARD

PRIVACY

Local first.
Transparent by design.

Alpha 1.0.0 does not use Cloudflare D1 and does not create a Nerdspace account. Twitch OAuth tokens are kept in sessionStorage and disappear when the browser session ends or you log out. Browser preferences and lightweight cache data use localStorage. TwitchTracker receives only the public channel name needed for a lookup. Nerdspace does not send your Twitch OAuth token to TwitchTracker.
